entries.title: VELOX
entries.ai_quote: made a game from grok try it out?

gameplay.input: Held W for about 1.6 seconds, then pressed F for about 0.5 seconds to begin the transform/takeoff sequence.
gameplay.response: W changed the HUD from 0 to 68 km/h (best 71 km/h) and moved the car along the road. F changed the HUD from Road mode to Transform, showing 15 km/h and altitude 2 m; the vehicle visibly shifted into its transforming state.

entries.title: 遥遥领先 (Yaoyao Lingxian) pixel flight runner

gameplay.response: The car visibly rose with thruster trails; the air reserve changed from 2.0 seconds to 1.4 seconds and the score advanced from 00000 to 00005. The game continued to display an ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED hint below the play area, but the local game responded to input.

prompts.A: Create a horizontal pixel-art cover for a one-button flight runner: a small white car with blue thruster trails rising between simple sky obstacles, with a tiny air-reserve meter motif and open sky. Match a retro runner; no text or logos. Center composition to survive square crop.
prompts.B: Create a horizontal retro pixel scene of a compact flying car banking upward above a cloud line, with a few geometric obstacle gates and a clear descent path. Keep original pixel art, with no words or brand marks. Center composition to survive square crop.

entries.title: Travel Dominoes
entries.ai_quote: Made this game with Manus AI. Beat my score?

gameplay.input: Started a match. After the computer played a double-3, selected the matching 5-3 tile, selected Left end, and clicked Confirm Move.
gameplay.response: The board visibly placed 5-3 connected to the double-3, displayed “You play 5-3,” changed the hand count from 7 to 6, and passed the turn to the computer.

warnings: post also contains a Manus referral/invite link

entries.title: No Taco? ("IS THAT A TACO?")
entries.ai_quote: IS THAT A TACO? 🌮 ... Made with Grok & Suno

gameplay.input: On a retry from the visible Run it back control, pressed Right in response to the visible taco-direction instruction.
gameplay.response: The round advanced and registered one correct decision: SCORE 100 and Eaten / dodged 1 / 0. The game later reached its three-wrong terminal screen at 4 / 50; the verified 100-point response and one correct decision remain visible there.

entries.title: Circix: Rewired
entries.ai_quote: AI Disclosure | AI Assisted | Code, Graphics

gameplay.input: Started the campaign; skipped the tutorial to expose the 3×3 puzzle; clicked the in-game Use hint control. Also tried clicking/dragging visible puzzle nodes through the nested game viewport using observed full-screen, frame-relative, and scaled coordinates.
gameplay.response: The in-game hint control visibly drew a purple connection from powered node 1 to adjacent node 2 and recorded the hint as used while the HUD remained Chapter 1, Level 1. Manual node selection/drag attempts did not visibly alter the puzzle; nested-canvas coordinates were not reliably delivered.

entries.title: Solo Crafting
entries.ai_quote: Claude Code built it in 3 days: Three.js, combat, bosses, a shadow army, multiplayer. No game engine.

gameplay.input: Clicked the game canvas to focus controls, then held W for about 1.2 seconds toward the visible gate.
gameplay.response: The guest entered the 3D town scene with 200/200 HP, 100/100 MP, and the daily quest HUD. After W movement, Travel (blocks) updated from 0 / 2000 to 7 / 2000.

warnings: RIGHTS: 'Solo Leveling' (trademarked anime/manhwa IP) named as the theme ('Solo Leveling, in the style of Minecraft'); style-similar Minecraft

prompts.A: Create a horizontal cover for a block-style fantasy exploration game: an original cloaked hunter entering a small cubic town through a gate, with a simple quest marker and distant tower. No recognizable franchise characters, logos, or text. Center composition to survive square crop.
prompts.B: Create a horizontal original voxel-inspired fantasy scene for a browser RPG: a guest adventurer walking from a town square toward a stone gate, with a restrained health-and-mana HUD motif. No recognizable franchise elements, lettering, or logos. Center composition to survive square crop.

entries.title: Bolt Pit
entries.ai_quote: my first web game, built with Claude Code, went live on CrazyGames today. Bolt Pit is a Three.js arena shooter.

gameplay.input: Dismissed the controller-detected overlay, clicked the visible game start prompt, then held W for about 1.2 seconds.
gameplay.response: The active arena showed a 0:04 timer, 3 KO, 3× STREAK, active character/enemy animation, and 3/3 hearts.

warnings: creator seen in priors only as 'froessell six games' (no play URLs), not this game
